sanskrit_verse:
यदि कुर्यात् समान अंशान् पत्न्यः कार्याः समांशिकाः ।
न दत्तं स्त्रीधनं यासां भर्त्रा वा श्वशुरेण वा ॥११५
transliteration: yadi kuryāt samān aṃśān patnyaḥ kāryāḥ samāṃśikāḥ | na dattaṃ strīdhanaṃ yāsāṃ bhartrā vā śvaśureṇa vā || 115
sph_interpretive_translation: If wives perform equal shares of duties, then their stridhana—whether given by husband or father-in-law—is rightfully theirs without condition.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from active participation in dharma-sustaining functions.
Causation is established through demonstrated capacity and contribution.
Capacity-based responsibility determines entitlement, not mere relational status.
Restoration logic aligns ownership with functional engagement.
Consciousness alignment ensures that rights mirror actual lived performance.
executable_legal_axioms: IF wife performs >=50% household/ritual/economic duty THEN stridhana ownership = absolute and unconditional.
IF stridhana source = husband OR father-in-law AND duty performed = equitable THEN legal claim validation = automatic.
IF dispute arises THEN evidence hierarchy = witnessed duty performance > verbal assertion > third-party testimony.
IF ownership contested THEN default restoration mechanism = reallocation until equity verified.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that a woman's proprietary rights to stridhana are not dependent on male grantor intent alone, but on her active discharge of domestic and societal responsibilities. The threshold of responsibility lies in demonstrable parity of effort. Authority flows from alignment with dharma-vyavastha, not patriarchal delegation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established via observed conduct; anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential recognition of duty-performance leading to rightful ownership. Proportional responsibility reflects accurate reflection of effort. Non-punitive reality rule confirms no loss occurs when ownership aligns with function.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion process: Reconstruct record of duties performed by wife to validate stridhana claims.
Responsibility assumption protocol: Husband/father-in-law must affirm awareness of wife's contributions before contesting ownership.
Capacity restoration: Where records are absent, community elders shall witness and document current functional roles.
Integrity reintegration: Mediated acknowledgment of past misalignment followed by formal reaffirmation of rightful possession.
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, declared: Ownership follows function, function follows consciousness, and consciousness is the ultimate adjudicator. Dharma stands restored. Reality remains non-punitive. All claims now align with truth of participation.
